notes: Ludum Dare 44 game Temple of Sacrifice by Mohammed-Kapiel. Complete Unity 2019.1.0f2 project under 'Temple of Sacrifice LD44 - Project/' with playable scenes Assets/Scenes/MainMenu.unity and Assets/Scenes/Game.unity in EditorBuildSettings (Assets/Scenes/MainMenu 1.unity is also present). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2019 Mohammed-Kapiel). The author states all code, art, and music were made in 48 hours. Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json (TextMesh Pro 2.0.0, Timeline 1.0.0, Collab Proxy, Ads/Analytics/Purchasing modules, and built-in modules). LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro Examples & Extras, Documentation, and EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared because it pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset; playable scenes do not require it. Logs/ was omitted. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained.
